# Desktop Buddy

> Desktop Buddy is a free animated desktop pet and reminder app for Windows 10 and 11, made by Devwerks. A character lives on your taskbar, keeps your to-do list and walks to the centre of your screen when a task is due.

## Key facts
- Price: free, no ads, no account required
- Platforms: Windows 10 and 11
- Install: https://github.com/Abhijith1001/Desktop_companion/releases/latest or `winget install Devwerks.DesktopBuddy`
- Works offline; data stays on your PC; cloud sync is optional and covers tasks only
- Features: five characters, reminders with Done/Snooze, repeating tasks, streaks and outfits, Pomodoro timer, habit tracker, water and stretch breaks
- Hide or show the buddy: Ctrl+Alt+B
